text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert - multiple GPU nodes reporting OOM resets + NCCL communicator errors. Auto-pager sent to on-call. Affected pods: tensor-parallel jobs in namespace 'inference-prod'. Symptoms: repeated container restarts, NCCL TIMEOUT / unhandled system errno, CUDA driver reset (Xid 116) on several nodes.
jen (SRE): ack — I'm looking at the cluster now. Which nodes?
alice (Oncall): i'm on it, taking pager. can someone post the node list and a failing pod name?
tom (Infra): nodes: gpu-node-12, gpu-node-17, gpu-node-24. Pod example: inference-prod/ttp-model-3-5f8d9. kube events show "OOMKilled" then node kernel log shows GPU reset. dmesg excerpt coming.
ivan (ML): those pods are running 4-way tensor parallel, batch sizes ~64. If NCCL breaks during rendezvous we see whole job stall. Impact likely any job pinned to >1 GPU.
liz (Support): confirmed customer report: AcmeCorp (cust-id: AC-904) filed support ticket #78910 — ~8 concurrent inference jobs, ~5 failed with 503s starting ~09:02 UTC. Customer reporting degraded throughput, some calls getting hung before error.
alice (Oncall): copying logs from failing pod:
```
I0315 09:02:18.431 pod.go:123] container started
E0315 09:02:53.982 nccl.cu:445] NCCL WARN NET/ERROR: unhandled system errno 104
E0315 09:02:53.983 cuda.cu:302] CUDA ERROR: driver shutting down (Xid 116)
E0315 09:02:54.001 worker.cc:210] TensorParallel rendezvous failed: communicator lost, aborting
```
alice (Oncall): running `kubectl describe pod inference-prod/ttp-model-3-5f8d9` shows process OOM of python worker, but node dmesg has repeated GPU resets. I'm cordoning gpu-node-17 now to stop new scheduling.
jen (SRE): good. also get `nvidia-smi -q` and `journalctl -u kubelet -n 200` from node before we reboot. Might be a driver/kernel regression surfaced by load.
tom (Infra): grabbed dmesg:
```
[ 1203.432154] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3c:00): 116, PID=7421, GPU-loss detected
[ 1203.432158] docker: container 9a7... killed due to OOM
[ 1203.432160] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 7421 (python) score 125 or sacrifice child
```
alice (Oncall): mitigation plan in-flight: 1) cordon + drain gpu-node-17 (ignore-daemonsets) 2) restart nvidia-persistenced and nvidia-container-runtime on the node 3) for active tensor-parallel jobs, trigger a fallback route to the 1-card replica set (route: model-ttp-fallback) to avoid cross-GPU collectives 4) scale up fallback by +3 instances to absorb load.
ivan (ML): immediate fallback to 1-card will reduce capacity but avoid NCCL rendezvous. We should set a temporary model-compat policy in router: `prefer-fallback-on-nccl-errors=true` and add header to calls so clients get degraded-latency notice.
liz (Support): telling AcmeCorp we're failing over to single-GPU workers now; they asked for ETA.
jordan (Customer): thanks — we're seeing big latency spikes, please advise ETA and if we should pause traffic.
alice (Oncall): ETA 12-18m for node remediation and scaled fallback capacity. if you can route non-critical traffic to fallback, do it now.
jen (SRE): while drain runs, collect `crashlog` and `kubectl logs --previous` from the crashed containers. add `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` to the fallback pods to collect more detail.
tom (Infra): i've restarted nvidia services on gpu-node-17 and cleared stale /dev/nvidia* handles. reboots avoided for now. node returns Ready; but gpu memory still shows fragmentation on node-12 and -24. recommend scheduling a rolling reboot of driver on those two after traffic stabilizes.
alice (Oncall): scaled up model-ttp-fallback by 3, updated router to prefer fallback. started draining node-17; 6 pods moved to fallback, 2 failed and restarted on CPU-only pool (short term).
ivan (ML): pushed a flag to runtime to avoid collective bootstrap for pipeline-parallel jobs when replica count < expected; that'll let partial jobs degrade gracefully. add to postmortem: evaluate smaller shard sizes / KV-cache partitioning.
liz (Support): AcmeCorp notified: we're seeing degraded throughput, failover applied, ETA 15m, support ticket updated #78910. they responded :thumbsup:.
alice (Oncall): monitoring errors — NCCL errors drop by ~80% after failover. still seeing isolated CUDA Xid 116 on node-12; taking it out of rotation next. will open incident follow-up and assign owner for driver regression triage.
jen (SRE): assigning postmortem owner: @ivan (ML) + @tom (Infra) for root cause triage. include runbook gap: detect driver resets earlier and auto-failover for tensor-parallel routes.
jordan (Customer): appreciate the quick response, keep us posted.
ops-rotations-bot: alice (Oncall) acknowledged the pager at 09:03 UTC. shift updated.
alice (Oncall): closing live pager — continuing remediation in channel. will post incident timeline and RCA draft in #postmortems within 48h. :white_check_mark:
